title: The projection formula
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact, quasi-separated morphism of schemes. For $E\in D_{\text{QCoh}}(\mathcal{O}_X)$ and $K\in D_{\text{QCoh}}(\mathcal{O}_Y)$ the canonical map $Rf_*(E)\otimes_{\mathcal{O}_Y}^{\mathbb L}K\to Rf_*(E\otimes_{\mathcal{O}_X}^{\mathbb L}Lf^*K)$ is an isomorphism; in particular, for an invertible $\mathcal{O}_Y$-module $\mathcal{N}$, $Rf_*(E)\otimes\mathcal{N}\cong Rf_*(E\otimes f^*\mathcal{N})$.

proof.text: For the invertible-module higher-direct-image case recorded in lean, use the already proved ordinary projection morphism projectionHom f M N, which is an isomorphism for invertible N. Check naturality in M on elementary tensors after the tensor-sheafification adjunction: whiskerRight_app_tmulSection and projectionHom_app_tmulSection identify both sides with phi(x) tensor eta(n). Thus this is a natural isomorphism between f_* followed by tensoring with N and tensoring with f^*N followed by f_*. This uses the projection-formula declarations recorded by lem-pc-closed-immersion-coherent-cohomology, which are valid for arbitrary f, not only closed immersions.

For an invertible module P, the proved tensor-dual evaluation P tensor P^dual is isomorphic to the unit. Mathlib BraidedCategory.tensorRightEquivalence therefore makes tensorRight P an equivalence. Apply this to N on T and f^*N on X, using invertibility of pullback. These tensor functors preserve injective objects, finite limits and finite colimits, and hence homology. Tensoring an injective resolution I of F with f^*N gives an injective resolution J of F tensor f^*N; its augmentation is the image of the original augmentation composed with the single-complex comparison.

Apply the natural ordinary projection-formula isomorphism termwise to I. It identifies f_*(I tensor f^*N) with f_*I tensor N as complexes. Take degree-q homology, using mapHomologyIso for the exact tensorRight N equivalence. Compose with J.isoRightDerivedObj and the tensor image of the inverse of I.isoRightDerivedObj. The result is R^q f_*(F tensor f^*N) isomorphic to R^q f_*F tensor N. This proves precisely the existing Lean declaration, with no qcqs hypotheses needed. The unrestricted unbounded D_QCoh statement in the natural-language node is broader than this existing Lean declaration and is not claimed by this delivery.
